findings.detail: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search. Route file doesn't exist. Test file explicitly documents 'will FAIL until route is implemented'. CI is broken on this today.

findings.title: vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read + Execution (CVSS 9.8)
findings.fix: npm update vitest --save-dev (→ 3.2.6+) in all 4 workspaces; never expose UI server beyond localhost
findings.detail: When Vitest UI server is listening, arbitrary files can be read or executed by any network-accessible user.

findings.title: Logger never pretty-prints in development — violates CLAUDE.md architecture rule
findings.detail: CLAUDE.md mandates pretty-printing in development. Logger always emits JSON regardless of NODE_ENV.
findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV check; emit human-readable format in development.

findings.title: 7 of 8 plan requirements files fail traceability enforcer — CI gate is a blind spot
findings.detail: Enforcer only checks the most-recently-modified plan. 7 plans fail when checked individually. Multi-app architecture not reflected in tooling.
findings.recommendation: Add --all flag with per-plan scope awareness (portal/ vs Source/).

findings.title: Duplicate test suites for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
findings.detail: 4 test files instead of 2 — top-level and tests/pages/ duplicates for both pages. Authoritative suite ambiguous.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into tests/pages/ structure; delete top-level duplicates.

findings.detail: src/utils/logger.ts (canonical) and src/logger.ts (shim) co-exist. Maintenance hazard.
findings.recommendation: Unify to single logger with one import path; delete shim.

findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md scope undocumented — creates misleading coverage picture
findings.detail: Spec governs portal/ but has no header declaring this. Automated scans against Source/ show 0% — alarming and wrong.
findings.recommendation: Add scope header to spec file; document two-app boundary in inspector.config.yml.

findings.title: getAllItems() called 3× unbounded per dashboard GET
findings.detail: Three full-store scans per request. Dashboard latency scales linearly with work item count.
findings.recommendation: Call getAllItems() once; reuse the cached array across all three computations.

findings.title: eslint-disable suppressions undocumented in 2 production frontend files
findings.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without explanation in useWorkItems.ts:63 and DependencyPicker.tsx:82.
findings.recommendation: Add inline comments explaining intentional omission, or refactor to satisfy linter.

findings.title: FR-dependency-seed never implemented — no seed.ts in Source/Backend
findings.detail: Dependency relationships cannot be reproduced for manual testing without hand-crafting API calls.
findings.recommendation: Implement utils/seed.ts with known items and dependency links; call from app.ts in development.
